title: Carry the Meadow's 60 fps criterion to the meadow-sweep thread and close this thread
context: This thread's build work is merged (PRs #241 to #243, #245, #247) and its listed cleanup is done. Its last open criterion, 366 flowers at 60 fps, is what the quality and performance sweep (PRs #258 to #260) set out to meet, and the 2026-10-03 device check measured it on the merged sweep: midnight holds 60 fps on the Note 10+, noon does not (water sparkles). Keeping the same criterion open on two threads would split its evidence.
options: keep this thread open beside the sweep thread
move the criterion, word for word with the owner's settling words, to thread meadow-sweep (01M42HJ47R06WVESJRZSXMQP1K) and close this one
outcome: Moved: meadow-sweep criterion 01M42HJ47P2RAS147T6HYHD7G6 carries the same text and the owner's words "366 flowers at 60 fps", with the device-pass benchmark as its check. This thread's copy is struck and the thread closes as done for its build work.
